source: User confirmation in the active task, relayed by the coordinating agent; this is not a client profession-pool record.
implementation_boundaries: Preserve each source's previously established ticket count; this observation establishes a free reserve option and creates no extra tickets.
Each real offered opportunity requires an independent once-consumable nonce and a recorded source occurrence.
Offer only an actual zero-hope reserve recruitment decision when profession and reserve identity are unobserved; do not draw or fabricate a character ID.
The unknown profession opportunity cannot recruit or promote Mechanist and cannot stand in for a dedicated upgrade ticket.
Only completing the actual recruitment triggers held echo-corn appraisal growth; acquiring, retaining, declining or discarding the opportunity does not.
Already-rolled same-screen item rewards remain available without rerolling, and the policy takes the pending item rewards before recruitment.
Concrete tickets and these observed opportunities share the established three-ticket retention capacity; stored opportunities can be retrieved only at FINAL, not EVACUATE.
This observation does not establish a free reserve option for every other generic event, shop service or recruitment-ticket family.
